scripts.setup: expo install expo-router expo-linear-gradient expo-blur expo-secure-store expo-clipboard expo-sharing expo-video react-native-safe-area-context react-native-screens react-native-webview react-native-reanimated react-native-gesture-handler react-dom react-native-web @expo/metro-runtime

into a day of native build errors.
